rules.sentence: A combination of ultrasound and MRI with diffusion tensor imaging may prove more helpful than ultrasound alone in helping to firm up a clinical diagnosis of inflammatory polyneuropathy.
MRI generally is more sensitive than ultrasound, as MRI can recognize muscle oedema as an early feature of denervation with greater sensitivity than ultrasound.
As neuropathy is a continual progressive disorder from mild to severe severity, using neural swelling as a sole criterion is always going to be limited.
